description: This file defines the RequestInterface, an interface representing an outgoing, client-side HTTP request within the PSR-7 HTTP message standard. It extends MessageInterface and includes method signatures for managing request targets, HTTP methods, and URIs, emphasizing immutability.

classes.name: RequestInterface
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for an outgoing, client-side HTTP request, including methods for accessing and modifying request target, method, and URI, with immutability guarantees.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns the request target string, which can be origin-form, absolute-form, authority-form, or asterisk-form, defaulting to '/' if none is set.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a new instance with a specified request target, enabling request target modifications while maintaining immutability.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP method of the request, such as GET, POST, PUT, etc.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP method, ensuring case sensitivity and validation according to HTTP standards.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI object associated with the request, conforming to UriInterface.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided URI, optionally preserving the Host header based on the preserveHost parameter.
